title: Galileo Got Bored in Church... and Changed Time Forever

segments.text: Galileo got bored in church, and it changed time forever.
Pisa, the fifteen-eighties. A young student is stuck in a very long sermon.
Instead of listening, he's watching a lamp swing from the ceiling.
The story goes, he timed each swing with his own pulse.
Big swings, small swings. Each one took the same time.
A perfectly steady beat. Exactly what a clock needs.
Back then, the best clocks drifted fifteen minutes a day.
Galileo sketched a pendulum clock, but died before he could build it.
Then in sixteen fifty-six, Christiaan Huygens finished the job.
His clock was off by just fifteen seconds a day.
Suddenly, a minute hand actually made sense.
